name: Markdown Plugin UI
description: UI sub-spec for the tabbed Markdown preview viewer: tab bar with drag-and-drop reorder, rendered preview area with scrollable content, and context menu interactions.

interactions.behavior: Switches to that tab (saves current scroll, loads new content, restores scroll)
Closes the tab; if last tab, shows 'No file loaded' placeholder
Reorders tabs via drag-and-drop (splice array, re-render)
Opens ContextMenu: Close, Close Others, Close All, Copy File Path

interactions.trigger: click on rendered link in preview
interactions.behavior: Opens external URL via electronAPI.shell.openExternal() or navigates internally (handled by custom renderer)

states.name: empty
states.description: No tabs open; shows 'No file loaded' in preview and 'No file loaded' in tab bar

states.name: tab-open
states.description: At least one tab open; preview shows rendered Markdown

states.name: rendering
states.description: Markdown is being parsed and rendered (synchronous but may show partial content)

states.name: error
states.description: Render error caught; shows 'Render error' in preview

states.name: file-deleted
states.description: External file was deleted; shows 'File deleted' in preview
